propositions: The completion verifier's verdict extraction selects the first parseable JSON object rather than the first schema-valid object, causing it to return quoted Dep records instead of CompletionVerdict when tool results contain dependency links.

The selection policy is deliberately schema-blind by design (first-wins to avoid draft/correction ambiguity) and shared across all LLM gates (plan-review, code-review, completion), making any fix a contract change affecting verification behavior beyond the verifier alone.

The fix requires three atomic layers: (1) sentinel-delimited output channel with last-block-wins (<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>>...<<<END>>>), (2) schema-filtered candidate selection (key-overlap screen + last-valid-wins + warning), and (3) invariant property tests, shipped with directive changes.

Experiments E1-E4 prove NativeOutput viable on Bedrock sonnet/haiku for no-tools steps but not for agentic verification (tools+thinking+native skips required calls), so the prompted path remains load-bearing for the verifier.
